front: Privileges needed to read a Unity Catalog table
back: `USE CATALOG` on the catalog, `USE SCHEMA` on the schema, `SELECT` on the table. Thiếu một trong ba thì query vẫn lỗi.

front: Do privileges granted on the metastore inherit to catalogs?
back: No. Metastore grants cover metastore operations such as `CREATE CATALOG`; `READ METADATA` is the exception. Grant data access ở catalog hoặc schema.

front: Does ownership inherit to child objects?
back: No, but the owner of a catalog or schema can manage every child object. Giao ownership object production cho group.

front: MANAGE vs owner
back: `MANAGE` grants, revokes, transfers ownership and drops, but does not include `SELECT` or `MODIFY`; many principals can hold it. Owner chỉ có một principal.

front: Let all users discover tables and request access without reading data
back: `GRANT BROWSE ON CATALOG ... TO account users`. BROWSE cho thấy tên, comment, tag mà không cần usage privilege.

front: Job permission: run now, cancel, view logs, no edits
back: CAN MANAGE RUN. Run now chạy bằng quyền của job owner.

front: SQL warehouse permission to run queries but not stop or edit
back: CAN USE. Stop, edit, delete cần IS OWNER hoặc CAN MANAGE.

front: Where can an ABAC policy be attached?
back: `METASTORE` (Beta), `CATALOG`, `SCHEMA` or `TABLE`; it applies to descendants. Docs khuyên gắn ở level cao nhất áp dụng được.

front: `has_tag()` in `MATCH COLUMNS` vs in `WHEN`
back: `MATCH COLUMNS` checks column tags only; `WHEN` checks table tags including tags inherited from catalog and schema. Tag không lan từ table xuống cột.

front: ABAC policy and materialized view refresh
back: The refresh runs as the pipeline owner or run-as identity; add it to `EXCEPT` or the stored data stays masked. Áp cho cả streaming table.

front: Two different row filters resolve for one user on one table
back: The query fails with an error; only one distinct row filter per table and one mask per column can resolve. Cùng UDF và cùng argument thì được.

front: Table-level row filter syntax
back: `ALTER TABLE t SET ROW FILTER fn ON (col)`; mask: `ALTER TABLE t ALTER COLUMN c SET MASK fn`. Drop row filter trước khi drop function.

ref.label: Manually apply row filters and column masks

front: Deterministic pseudonymization in a mask UDF
back: `sha2(concat(val, CAST(version AS STRING)), 256)` marked `DETERMINISTIC`; bump `version` to rotate. Cùng input cho cùng hash ở mọi table.

ref.label: Common patterns for row filtering and column masking

front: Are hashed identifiers anonymous under GDPR?
back: No. Data that can be re-attributed with additional information is pseudonymized personal data. Chỉ anonymous data mới ngoài phạm vi GDPR.

front: Erase rows from a table with deletion vectors
back: `DELETE`, then `REORG TABLE ... APPLY (PURGE)`, then `VACUUM` after the retention window. Deletion vector chỉ soft-delete.

front: Stream from a Delta table that receives GDPR deletes
back: Delete downstream rows with DML and read the source with `skipChangeCommits`. Materialized view tự xử lý delete.

ref.label: GDPR and CCPA compliance with Delta Lake

front: What does Data Classification produce?
back: System tags such as `class.email_address` on detected columns and results in `system.data_classification.results`. Dùng tag đó trong ABAC policy.

front: SQL warehouse: CAN USE vs CAN MONITOR
back: CAN USE starts the warehouse and runs queries; CAN MONITOR adds viewing all warehouse queries and the monitoring tab. Stop, edit cần IS OWNER hoặc CAN MANAGE.

front: Usage privileges needed to exercise MANAGE
back: MANAGE on a catalog: none. On a schema: `USE CATALOG` on the parent. On a table: `USE CATALOG` and `USE SCHEMA`. Đọc data vẫn cần đủ usage privilege và SELECT.

front: Stop even object owners from managing grants
back: ABAC DENY policy (Beta) on `MANAGE ACCESS CONTROL`; it overrides any grant, including ownership. Privilege này chỉ deny được, không grant được.

front: ABAC policies on views
back: Beta, DBR 19+, workspace preview; not on metric views; at most 20 layered policies per query. `CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW` xoá tag và policy gắn trực tiếp.

front: Underlying files of a materialized view and PII
back: They can hold upstream columns outside the MV definition to support incremental refresh. Không share storage path của MV cho consumer không tin cậy.
